fields.name: Gordon & MacPhail
fields.description: Founded 1895 in Elgin. One of the most respected independent bottlers, renowned for exceptionally aged and rare expressions.

fields.name: Signatory Vintage
fields.description: Founded 1988. Independent bottler specializing in single cask, cask strength bottlings. Owns Edradour distillery.

fields.name: Cadenhead's
fields.description: Scotland's oldest independent bottler, established 1842. Known for no-chill-filtered, natural colour bottlings.

fields.name: Douglas Laing
fields.description: Family-owned since 1948. Known for Old Particular, Provenance, and XOP ranges. Single cask specialists.

fields.name: Berry Bros. & Rudd
fields.description: Britain's oldest wine and spirits merchant, established 1698. Known for Blue Hanger and Classic Range bottlings.

fields.name: Compass Box
fields.description: Founded 2000. Artisan whisky maker known for innovative blended malts and blends. Advocates for transparency.

fields.name: Adelphi Distillery
fields.description: Re-established 1993. Selects exceptional single casks bottled at natural strength without chill-filtration.

fields.name: Hunter Laing
fields.description: Founded 2013 by the Laing family. Known for Old Malt Cask and Hepburn's Choice ranges.

fields.name: Murray McDavid
fields.description: Founded 1996. Pioneer of cask finishing techniques. Part of Aceo Ltd group.

fields.name: The Scotch Malt Whisky Society
fields.description: Founded 1983. Members' club bottling single cask whiskies with cryptic tasting-note names instead of distillery names.

fields.name: Duncan Taylor
fields.description: Founded 1938. Holds one of the largest inventories of rare Scotch casks. Known for Octave and Peerless ranges.

fields.name: A.D. Rattray
fields.description: Re-established 2002, originally founded 1868. Cask Collection features single cask bottlings from across Scotland.

fields.name: Blackadder International
fields.description: Swedish-Scottish independent bottler. Known for Raw Cask series, bottled unfiltered with cask residue.

fields.name: Ian Macleod Distillers
fields.description: Family-owned since 1933. Owns Glengoyne and Tamdhu distilleries. Known for Chieftain's and Dun Bheagan ranges.

fields.name: Wemyss Malts
fields.description: Family-owned. Bottlings named by flavour rather than distillery. Owns Kingsbarns and Darnley's Gin distilleries.

fields.name: Thompson Brothers
fields.description: Young independent bottlers known for excellent cask selections. Also own Dornoch Distillery.

fields.name: Elixir Distillers
fields.description: Founded by Sukhinder and Rajbir Singh. Known for The Single Malts of Scotland and Elements of Islay ranges.

fields.name: That Boutique-y Whisky Company
fields.description: Part of Atom Group. Known for distinctive comic-book label art and creative small batch bottlings.
